description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Gruul Turf's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
